fix_applied.change: Added useRootNavigationState import from expo-router. Added guard check (!navigationState?.key) before loading/user checks in NavigationGuard useEffect. Added navigationState?.key to useEffect dependency array.
fix_applied.reason: In expo-router v6, router.replace() called during initial page load (before navigation stack is ready) is silently dropped. useRootNavigationState provides the key that signals when navigation is ready. This fixes full-page-load deep link scenarios (e.g., direct browser navigation to /map or /login).
fix_applied.root_cause: expo-router v6 requires navigation state to be initialized before router.replace() works. The original NavigationGuard fired useEffect immediately when loading became false, but at that point the navigation stack might not yet be ready. useRootNavigationState().key is undefined until the stack is initialized, providing the correct gate.

rca_of_issue.bug: NavigationGuard (useEffect with router.replace) not working for full page loads / deep links
rca_of_issue.root_cause: In expo-router v6, when the app is loaded via direct URL navigation (full page reload), router.replace() calls made inside useEffect may fire BEFORE the navigation stack (react-navigation) is fully initialized. These calls are silently dropped.
rca_of_issue.reproduction: 1. Login to get token. 2. Use browser.goto('/login') for full page reload. 3. checkAuth() runs, finds token, sets user. 4. NavigationGuard fires router.replace('/(tabs)/map'). 5. URL stays at /login (replace is dropped).
rca_of_issue.fix: Add const navigationState = useRootNavigationState() and check if (!navigationState?.key) return before executing redirects. This ensures router.replace() is only called after the navigation stack is ready.
rca_of_issue.reference: expo-router v6 docs: 'Use useRootNavigationState to defer navigation until the navigator is mounted'
